items.source: Resolve a map of all beans of the given type, also picking up beans defined in ancestor bean factories, with the specific condition that each bean actually has autowire candidate status. This matches simple injection point resolution as implemented by this AutowireCandidateResolver strategy, including beans which are not marked as default candidates but excluding beans which are not even marked as autowire candidates.
items.translation: 解析给定类型的所有 Bean 的 Map，同时从祖先 Bean 工厂中获取定义的 Bean，但需满足每个 Bean 实际上具有自动装配候选状态这一特定条件。此操作与由本AutowireCandidateResolver策略实现的简单注入点解析相匹配，包括未标记为默认候选的 Bean，但不包括甚至未标记为自动装配候选的 Bean。

items.source: AutowireCandidateResolver implementation to use when no annotation support is available. This implementation checks the bean definition only.
items.translation: AutowireCandidateResolver 实现，在无法使用注解支持时使用。此实现仅检查 Bean 定义。

items.source:
Resolve a map of all beans of the given type, also picking up beans defined in
ancestor bean factories, with the specific condition that each bean actually
has autowire candidate status.
items.translation: 解析给定类型的所有 Bean 的 Map，同时从祖先 Bean 工厂中获取定义的 Bean，但前提是每个 Bean 必须具有自动装配候选状态。

items.source: BeansException - if a bean could not be created
items.translation: BeansException - 如果无法创建 Bean

items.source: type - the type of bean to match
items.translation: type - 要匹配的 Bean 类型

items.source: the Map of matching bean instances, or an empty Map if none
items.translation: 匹配 Bean 实例的 Map，如果没有则为空 Map。
`cloneIfNecessary` 接口 `AutowireCandidateResolver` 中

items.source: allowEagerInit - whether to initialize lazy-init singletons and objects created by FactoryBeans (or by factory methods with a "factory-bean" reference) for the type check. Note that FactoryBeans need to be eagerly initialized to determine their type: So be aware that passing in "true" for this flag will initialize FactoryBeans and "factory-bean" references.
items.translation: allowEagerInit - 是否要在类型检查期间初始化懒加载单例和由 FactoryBeans 创建的对象（或由带有“factory-bean"引用的工厂方法创建的对象）。请注意，FactoryBeans 需要被急切初始化以确定其类型：因此，请留意将此标志设置为 "true" 将导致 FactoryBeans 和"factory-bean"引用被初始化。

items.source: includeNonSingletons - whether to include prototype or scoped beans too or just singletons (also applies to FactoryBeans)
items.translation: includeNonSingletons - 是否包含原型或作用域 Bean，还是仅包含单例（同样适用于 FactoryBean）
